o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bẹ̄ĺ (“five”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰋𐱁 (b²š /⁠beš⁠/, “five”).
Borrowed from Russian реда́ктор (redáktor), from French rédacteur.
From Persian خیر (xeyr); ultimately from the same source as xeyir.
From Proto-Turkic *kïŕ (“expensive, miserly”). Cognate with Turkish kıskanmak.
